# Summary and questions


# Pattern Matching

:::{#def-pattern-matching .callout-note icon="false"}
Given pattern $P$ of length $m$ and a text $T$ of length $n$, the classical Exact Pattern Matching problem asks to identify the fragments of $T$ that match $P$ exactly: $Occ(P, T) = \{i \in [0, n-m] \mid P = T[i, i+m)\}$.
:::
